offer_hypotheses.target_customer_segment: AI startup founders and owner-operators who need evidence-backed decisions before outreach or publication
offer_hypotheses.problem_statement: Founders need credible external research and decision briefs without accidental side effects.
offer_hypotheses.proposed_solution: A governed read-only observation sprint that produces evidence packets, conflict notes, and a CEO command brief.
offer_hypotheses.caveats: Market willingness-to-pay remains a hypothesis until approved customer discovery.
offer_hypotheses.pricing_hypothesis: founder pilot package at $500-$1500 per scoped internal research sprint
offer_hypotheses.delivery_model: internal-only deliverable, reviewed by owner before any external use
offer_hypotheses.fastest_validation_path: human-reviewed offer one-pager plus approved outreach in a future sprint

offer_hypotheses.target_customer_segment: solo founders coordinating AI agents across research, operations, engineering, and revenue
offer_hypotheses.problem_statement: Owners need one clear cockpit for agent team status, money path, blocked actions, and approval queue.
offer_hypotheses.proposed_solution: Owner cockpit setup with revenue radar, offer hypotheses, approval workflow, and writeback dry-run queue.
offer_hypotheses.caveats: Cockpit value improves once approved execution and feedback capture are added.
offer_hypotheses.pricing_hypothesis: monthly internal operations cockpit retainer at $300-$1000 after pilot validation
offer_hypotheses.delivery_model: private owner-facing dashboard artifacts and weekly command brief
offer_hypotheses.fastest_validation_path: use cockpit v2 internally for next two commercial sprints
